Coordinator, after drafting: lemma keys with ad-hoc sense suffixes (-G, -up, -syll, -pres, -in, -while, -hold, -yield, -N2) were folded into the house lemma (bare lemma, or lemma-STEM for D/Š/N stems, as kânum-D / nadānum-N in earlier parts); the glosser broadens the known entry instead. units.json is now ahead of make_units.py/units_text.py — edit units.json, not the scripts.
